summary: Discussion of pediatric diseases and treatments

sections.title: Pediatric Diseases Chapter One
sections.originalText: 小儿者，纯阳之体，易寒易热，易虚易实。
sections.translation: Children are pure yang bodies, easily affected by cold and heat, easily becoming deficient or excessive.
sections.interpretation: This chapter describes the unique physiological characteristics of children and corresponding treatment principles.

keyConcepts.description: Medical practice focused on children's health and diseases
